# Pinned runtime dependencies for the vendored sundael package (see VENDOR.md).
# Versions mirror the upstream sundael .venv at vendoring time (sundael v1.0.0,
# commit 50e75ab). Install into a DEDICATED venv -- these conflict with
# graphgym's main .venv (which runs pandas 3 / numpy 2.5; sundael needs
# pandas<3 and numba, which doesn't support numpy that new).
#
#   uv venv --python 3.13 .venv-sundael
#   .venv-sundael/bin/python -m pip install -r third_party/sundael/requirements.txt
#
# Then run the disaggregation step with that interpreter:
#   .venv-sundael/bin/python scratch_sundael_transfer.py
#
# Scoring (notebooks/sundael_metrics.py) does NOT need this -- run it in
# graphgym's main .venv as usual.
numba==0.62.1
llvmlite==0.45.1
numpy==2.3.5
pandas==2.3.3
pandera==0.32.1
polars==1.43.2
pyarrow==25.0.1
pvlib==0.15.2
scipy==1.18.0
seaborn==0.13.2
structlog==26.1.0
pydantic==2.13.4
joblib==1.5.3
requests==2.34.2
